Finance (No. 2) Act 2024: Securities Transaction Tax (STT) Equity Delivery
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024, Chapter VII — Securities Transaction Tax: Under Section 98 and Section 99, taxable securities transactions in Equity Delivery on recognized stock exchanges shall be levied at 0.1% (one-tenth of one percent) payable by both the purchaser and seller. Finance (No. 2) Act 2024, Chapter IV amendments to Section 112A and Section 111A of the Income-tax Act, 1961: 1. Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) on listed equity shares, equity-oriented units, and business trust units held > 12 months are taxed at 12.5% (increased from 10%) for transfers on or after July 23, 2024. The annual aggregate LTCG exemption limit under Section 112A was increased from INR 1,00,000 to INR 1,25,000. 2. Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG) under Section 111A on listed equities held <= 12 months are taxed at 20% (increased from 15%). • Risk Management & Stop-Loss Parameters: Enforce a strict trailing stop-loss at ₹15.14 (representing a 12 percent tolerance threshold from the anchor price, aligning with historical volatility bounds and parametric VaR limits).

• Milestone Target 1: ₹24.50 (+42.4% gain) - Trim 30 percent of basket exposure.

• Milestone Target 3: ₹61.20 (P90 upside projection) - Liquidate remaining structural holdings.
